payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the unique characteristics of user-generated text that necessitate the use of ESE methods, highlighting the limitations of existing benchmarks and the need for new evaluation metrics.

claims.text: User-generated text has distinct characteristics, such as multifaceted, non-named, and vague entities, which are not well captured by existing benchmarks.
The performance of state-of-the-art ESE methods is often inferior on user-generated text compared to simpler baselines due to these unique characteristics.
New benchmarks are required for user-generated text to effectively evaluate ESE methods, as existing benchmarks do not adequately represent its complexities.
